messages:
Asha (Finance): Heads-up: new billing clarity & quota behaviors go live 2026-05-01. This affects short burst charging, invoice timing, and gradual free-credit tapering for high sustained usage. Please don't copy externally until comms are published next week. :loudspeaker:

Sam (Ops): TL;DR for infra teams? Any rate-limit code changes required?

Asha (Finance): No rate-limit algorithm changes. Main items:
- "grace burst" = one contiguous 24h grace period per 7-day rolling window (auto-applied)
- sustained surcharge = triggered after 7 consecutive days above 50% reserved throughput or >2x baseline
- invoices finalized on 3rd business day with explicit line items for credits/surcharges

Riley (Product): How will this show up in the UI/invoice? Need copy for AEs.

Asha (Finance): Dashboard will show a soft warning at 70% quota. Invoices include codes: BURST_GRACE_CREDIT and SUSTAINED_SURCHARGE with short notes. Small example line: {"code":"BURST_GRACE_CREDIT","amount":"-$30","note":"1x 24h grace"}

Lynn (Support): Are credits automatic? What about disputes?

Asha (Finance): Burst grace credits auto-apply. Disputed sustained surcharges go to billing ops queue for manual review (5 business days SLA). Playbook + canned replies to be posted tomorrow in #support-channels.

BillingBot: Note: free-credit taper begins 2026-06-01 for accounts that hit sustained thresholds; prorated adjustments + 30-day notice. Rule: FC-TAPER-2026.

Sam (Ops): We'll add the banner and a /quota-check endpoint for internal validation. Ops and product to sync on the banner wording today.

Riley (Product): Rollout plan?

Asha (Finance): Internal docs: 2026-04-10. Early notices to impacted customers: 2026-04-20. Public FAQ & blog: 2026-04-30. Enforcement: burst grace 2026-05-01; credit taper 2026-06-01. Exceptions: negotiated enterprise terms and active pilot flags remain exempt.

Lynn (Support): Thanks — will prep AE templates and escalation steps once you drop the playbook.
